input.summary: Delete Customer-payable liquidated damages for dependency delays; replace with excused performance and equitable schedule adjustment.
input.comment: [Playbook] We do not accept liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer, so we have removed the USD 25,000 per day charge for dependency delays. Instead, Vendor is excused from affected obligations and gets an equitable adjustment to the schedule, which addresses the underlying delay risk without a punitive payment.

ops.oldText: 7.6 Customer shall pay Vendor USD 25,000 per day as agreed liquidated damages for any delay in providing a dependency.
ops.newText: 7.6 If Customer delays in providing a dependency, Vendor shall be excused from performance of the affected obligations to the extent and for so long as the delay prevents such performance, and the affected delivery dates and schedules shall be equitably adjusted. Customer shall have no liability for liquidated damages, penalties or other pre-agreed amounts in respect of such delay.
